summary: Backend regression + targeted coverage for iter15 follow-up fixes (completion_note Form binding + new _clear_stale_price_adjustment_fields helper). Authored /app/backend/tests/test_iter15_form_and_stale_clear.py (6 tests, all PASS): TestCompletionNoteFormBinding (2 — note now persists when sent as multipart form data; default '' still works when omitted), TestClearStalePriceAdjustment (4 — re-approval at LOWER price clears stale token/adjusted_price/requires_customer_approval and reverts status to pending_payment; re-approval at SAME price also clears stale state when present; approve with NO booking attached + lower price succeeds without error; approve at lower price when booking has no stale fields leaves booking untouched). Also updated existing test_completion_upload_success_persists_path_and_note in test_quote_approval_completion_refactor.py to use data= (multipart) instead of params= (query) — confirms the form-binding fix end-to-end. Combined regression run: 74/75 PASSED (6 iter15 + 11 iter14 + 7 iter13 + 50 prior). Single failure is a pre-existing flaky AI-cache test (TestDescriptionAwareImageCache.test_same_image_different_description_is_cache_miss) — passed on individual retry; not related to iter15 changes.

minor.issue: test_same_image_different_description_is_cache_miss is flaky in suite mode but passes on retry (PRE-EXISTING from iter14, not iter15 regression). Symptom: hit.total_price (95.0) != miss.total_price (150.0). RCA hypothesis: AI returns variable prices for similar images and the cache-miss path stores the FIRST AI response while a subsequent identical request occasionally re-runs the AI before the cache row is committed. Re-running the test alone passes consistently. Consider deterministic fixture price or polling on cache_key insert before issuing the second call.

Pre-existing from iter14: _process_quote_price_increase still swallows ALL send_sms exceptions while flipping booking to pending_customer_approval. Customer waits for SMS that never arrives. Iter15 did not address this.

action_items: (Optional) Stabilize TestDescriptionAwareImageCache.test_same_image_different_description_is_cache_miss — currently flaky in suite mode. Either await db.image_cache.find_one({cache_key:...}) before issuing the HIT request, or stub AI to deterministic price for the same (image_hash, description_norm).
(Optional, carried over from iter14) Surface SMS failures in _process_quote_price_increase rather than warn-logging — booking is otherwise stranded in pending_customer_approval forever.
critical_code_review_comments: _clear_stale_price_adjustment_fields is correctly scoped: looks up booking by quote_id, returns silently if no booking, returns silently if no stale fields, otherwise $unsets the five stale fields and $sets status='pending_payment'. Verified all four branches end-to-end. One nit: the helper hard-codes status='pending_payment' but never validates the previous booking status — if the booking was in some other terminal state (cancelled, refunded), this would clobber it. Realistically the only path to having stale customer_approval_token is via _process_quote_price_increase which sets status='pending_customer_approval', so this is currently safe, but a tighter guard ({'status':'pending_customer_approval'} in the update filter) would future-proof it.

approve_quote refactor double-fetches the booking: _process_quote_price_increase OR _clear_stale_price_adjustment_fields each do their own db.bookings.find_one({quote_id}), then _send_quote_approval_decision_email does a THIRD identical lookup. Three round-trips per approval — pass the booking down or memoize.

completion_note: str = Form(default='') fix is correct. Note that File(...) and Form(...) annotations together force FastAPI to treat the request body as multipart, which is exactly what the frontend sends.

Pre-existing carry-overs: server.py is now 3907 lines (was 3878 in iter14, 3865 in iter13). The two helpers added in iter15 are 22 lines net but the file continues to grow. Approve_quote helpers (~170 lines) + completion helpers (~80 lines) + the 4 quote_*_html builders (~250 lines) are obvious extraction candidates into routers/quotes.py and routers/bookings.py.
_save_completion_photo still uses datetime.now() (naive local time) for the filename suffix — two completions in the same wall-clock second overwrite each other. Carry-over from iter14.
